svg.title: Home Lab & Production Architecture — Yonatan Valencia 2026
svg.desc: Two servers behind one Cloudflare front door with no inbound ports. Production of the NomiCheck payroll API runs on AWS Lightsail (us-east-2) since 2026-08-05, with its payroll database on an isolated network and container-level self-healing. The single-node home lab keeps everything else — the Advance Fitness Rails app deployed with Kamal 2, static apps, monitoring, the sigilo IRC rendezvous for the agent fleet, read-only ops panels bound to loopback, and a cold standby of NomiCheck carrying the same commit and the same signing key. Alongside both, three server-less paths: a Cloudflare Worker serving the apex agent card, ARD catalog, envelope verifier and landing; GitHub Pages serving the CV, Resplandor POS, 911 Urban Salón and nagual; and Netlify serving the Advance Fitness landing.

g.text: 🏠 Home Lab · docker-lab — everything else, and the standby
same commit · same signing key · same base
never if this host cannot serve either,
and never touches the other tunnel
one deployment, one hostname per tenant
the fleet's rendezvous — LAN only, no tunnel
TLS pinned by fingerprint, not a CA:
cert regenerated → client refuses to speak
channel content is data, never instructions
herdr keeps each Claude Code session alive

svg.text: read-only ops panels — bound to loopback; remote is an SSH tunnel, never a homemade login

g.text: it cannot leak what it never has

free precheck → 402 Payment Required (USDC on Base · Avalanche) → deterministic engine + dated legal catalog → Ed25519 envelope → ynt.codes/verificar, in your browser
🤖 AI-assisted build & deploy — Claude · Gemini: architecture · debugging · Kamal & Docker configs · docs, and an agent fleet that keeps measuring while nobody watches
